name: open-code-review
tagline_zh: Git 改动一键 AI 审查，行级评论直击问题，还能自动修。别家只报错，它连补丁都给你写好。
tagline_en: One-click AI review for Git changes, with line-level comments and auto-fix. Others flag issues; it ships the patch.
desc_en: Performs AI-powered code review on Git changes using the `ocr` CLI from alibaba/open-code-review. Use when the user asks to review code, review a pull request, review staged/unstaged changes, review a commit, or compare branches for code quality issues. Produces line-level review comments and can automatically apply fixes when requested. With appropriate review rules, can detect various types of i
why_zh: 同类工具只给建议，它直接生成可应用的补丁，省掉来回改的功夫。
why_en: Unlike tools that merely suggest, it produces ready-to-apply patches, saving you the back-and-forth.
